summary: RinPy is a modern pip-installable Python package designed for constructing and analyzing Residue Interaction Networks (RINs) from protein structures and ensembles. It represents proteins as graphs with nodes as residues, nucleotides, or ligands, and edges representing residue-level interactions weighted by local interaction strength. Nodes carry attributes like chain ID, residue number, and Cartesian position. RinPy supports single and multiple PDB structures, large ensembles, MD-derived structures, protein–RNA/DNA complexes, and ligands. Core analyses include degree, closeness, and betweenness centrality, with extendable NetworkX-based measures. It offers graph spectral and community analysis to identify organization, hinge regions, and coupling.
